doc.title: Manuel "Fess" Manetta and Edward "Kid" Ory Interview, 1958-08-26

title: Oliver leaves for Chicago with Jimmy Noone
summary: Ory turns the job over to Oliver, who takes a Chicago telegram offer and Jimmy Noone, and Ory gives them train money.

story.theme_name: Chicago: the jazz migration and its clubs
story.community_name: Going north: working the Chicago jazz scene

blocks.x: And that's the night Joe, I told him, he said, I'm going to leave here. I had an offer to go to Chicago. He had a telegram. I said, you want to leave town? He said, I said, yeah. Right this guy. I said, I don't want to go. All right now. And Joe was taking the job and he had Jimmy to go with him. And I went station with them and it was broke, the Ten Commandments. And I said, how you boys sick for your lunch on the train? They haven't gotten any money. So I gave him $10 each, Jimmy and Joe.

Yeah. He was playing with me at the time, Joe. I got a telegram. And right after it was ready, Joe made up his mind to leave. And I had a telegram. I didn't want to go. So I turned the job over to Joe. And he's taking Jimmy with him.
